name: Environment Ready & Handoff to AI Setup

transitions.provenance: structural — Subscription board 6 on P08, 11 September 2026
structural — the book's handoff, 6.10: "This hands the customer directly to Board 7", 11 September 2026

notes:
**Moved from P09 `ADM-428` on 11 September 2026.** Board 6 is worked by the new customer's own administrator inside their tenant, not by TICVAI; `tools/applied/apply-subscription-placement.py` records why. `ADM-428` is retired and never reissued.

The pack's flow text ("Initial Configuration - 42%", arrows, board headings) is narrative, not fields; the screen tells the customer the environment is ready and hands over to AI setup (BO-595).
patternReason: the pack gives this screen a configuration directory (§Configuration Status; AI Configuration prepares; Initial Configuration Prepared) and no display directory — it is settings, not a population
purpose: Confirm that provisioning is complete and move the customer into Board 7. Enable customers to complete their TICVAI configuration independently using a combination of AI-guided setup, natural-language configuration, venue templates, guided tasks, and traditional manual configuration.

gaps.why: **Environment Ready & Handoff to AI Setup declares no operation that writes anything** — its only declared call is `none`, a read. The name promises authoring and the contract offers none, so either the write operations are missing or this screen is a view of something another screen builds.

components.notes: **Cursor pagination, never offset** — offset drifts under concurrent writes, which on a venue's busiest hour is a list that skips rows.

states.loading: The environment ready handoff configuration as saved.
states.error: Could not load. Names which read failed and leaves the environment ready handoff untouched.
states.emptyFirstRun: No environment ready handoff configured yet. Offers no create action — this screen declares no operation that makes one; distinct from a filter that matched nothing.
states.emptyNoAccess: Names the missing permission. **Never an empty table** — that reads as *there is no data* and sends somebody to support with the wrong question.
states.emptyNoResults: **Nothing matched.** The filter or the scope narrowed it — naming which is what stops somebody concluding the record does not exist

wireframe.workshopBoard: wireframes/WS158 Subscription Licensing AI Self Service Board 6.dc.html#bo-594

apisNote: Regenerated 9 September 2026 from Subscription_Licensing_AI_Self_Service.pdf page 80. 0 of 0 labels bound to a contract property; 6 of 83 pack bullets carried onto the screen — the rest are acceptance prose, worked examples and AI narrative, which belong to the matrix and the contracts rather than here.

name: Organisation

navigation.notes: Reached from BO-100 Venue Home (Setup) and from BO-064 Zones & Areas, which keeps zones and areas and links here for departments (client feedback of 6 October 2026, N32; CHG-R6-040).

notes: **Created 12 October 2026 (CHG-R6-040) from the client's feedback of 6 October** ("some of the basic setup is not there such as Departments, Sub Departments ... and it's confusing"; design-r1/COMMAND.md, ADDED 6 Oct). Venue Management had no organisation tree: departments existed only through the Create org unit button of BO-064 Zones & Areas and the wave-3 BO-145, and the tree itself is ADM-006, in the console. **This screen is the venue's department, sub-department and outlet tree**, on the org units the package already has (`listOrgUnits`, `createOrgUnit`, `getOrgUnit`, `updateOrgUnit`); every "choose a department" field (outlets, BO-055 Rota & Scheduling, products) reads the same tree. **Archive is deactivate**: `updateOrgUnit` with `isActive` false, which makes every permission query at or beneath the unit resolve to deny and deletes nothing. Block B (Chinmay's decision on N32).
patternReason: `listOrgUnits` reads the tree and `getOrgUnit` reads one unit of it — list, select, act
purpose: Keep the venue's departments, sub-departments and outlets as one tree that every department picker reads.

components.label: Level
components.notes: Sends `?level=` to `listOrgUnits`. Offers Department, Sub-department and Outlet; the levels above the venue are the console's (ADM-006).

components.label: Show archived
components.notes: Sends `?includeInactive=` to `listOrgUnits`. Off by default, so an archived unit leaves the tree and the pickers.

components.label: Departments, sub-departments and outlets
components.notes: `listOrgUnits` with `?under=` the venue's path, so the tree starts at the venue the session holds. Each node shows its level, name and how many units sit directly under it (`childCount`). Cursor-paged: a large venue loads the next page as the tree is scrolled.

components.label: Add a unit
components.notes: Adds a department under the venue, a sub-department under a department, or an outlet under either; the selected unit is the parent.

components.label: Archive unit
components.notes: Sends `isActive` false. **Everything at or beneath the unit is denied from then on**; nothing is deleted, and Show archived brings it back to restore (`isActive` true).

states.loading: The venue's tree, read by `listOrgUnits` under the venue's path.
states.error: Could not load. Names which read failed and leaves the tree untouched.
states.emptyFirstRun: No departments yet. Offers Add a unit (`createOrgUnit`) with Department chosen; the department pickers on BO-055 and the outlet and product screens show nothing to choose until one exists.
states.emptyNoResults: Nothing matches the Level or Show archived filter and the tree is still there. Names the active filter and offers to clear it.
states.emptyNoAccess: Shown when the caller lacks `SCOPE_VIEW`, which `listOrgUnits` requires to show this screen, and names that permission. **Never an empty tree.** A caller who can see the screen but lacks `SCOPE_MANAGE` (`createOrgUnit`, `updateOrgUnit`, held at brand level) sees Add a unit, Rename unit and Archive unit disabled, naming that permission.
states.validation: `400` on a code that is not lower-case letters, digits and underscores, or a level that cannot sit under the selected parent; `409` on a code already used under that parent. Marked on the field.

apis.purpose: The tree under the venue, and the units under the selected one
Add a department, sub-department or outlet
Rename, archive or restore a unit

params.name: orgUnitId
params.notes: Opened without it, the screen shows the venue's tree and the user picks a unit; an edge that holds one (BO-064) may carry it to open on that unit.

entryState.coldEntry: Resolves the tenant and venue from the session, never from the link; a unit the session cannot see is said to be out of reach, not silently dropped.

overlays.body: **Collects what `createOrgUnit` sends before it is called.** Required: `level` (Department, Sub-department or Outlet), `code` (lower-case, fixed once created), `name`. `parentId` is the selected unit, never typed. Dismissing sends nothing; the tree behind is unchanged.
**Collects what `updateOrgUnit` sends before it is called.** Optional: `name`. The code and the place in the tree do not change. Dismissing sends nothing.
**Archive *Food & Beverage* and the 4 units under it?** Staff granted at or beneath it lose that access until it is restored; nothing is deleted. `updateOrgUnit` with `isActive` false.

gaps.why: **Move is not in the contract.** A unit's code is the last segment of its ltree path and is fixed once created, and no operation re-parents a unit; the client's "add, edit, move and archive" gets add, rename and archive. Moving a department is archive and re-create until an operation exists (CHG-R6-040).

**The counts under each node are only the child count.** `OrgUnit` carries `childCount`; the outlets, staff and products under a unit (asked for in the wireframe intent) have no read that counts them by unit (CHG-R6-040).
